queries.CR_MODIFIES_hub_paths: SELECT e.* FROM edge e JOIN CR c ON c.node_id=e.src_id JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE e.rel_type='MODIFIES' AND s.specRelease IS NULL ORDER BY e.edge_id
queries.IN_RELEASE_OF: SELECT e.* FROM edge e JOIN Spec s ON s.node_id=e.src_id JOIN Spec t ON t.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE e.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' ORDER BY e.edge_id
queries.RRCParameter_own_parent: SELECT DISTINCT p.*,s.sectionId AS parentSectionId,s.level AS parentLevel FROM RRCParameter p JOIN edge e ON e.src_id=p.node_id AND e.rel_type='definedInSection' JOIN Section s ON s.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE p.specNumber='38.331' AND s.sectionId LIKE '38.331-Rel-19-%' ORDER BY p.ieName,s.sectionId
queries.Section: SELECT * FROM Section ORDER BY node_id
queries.Section_BELONGS_TO_SPEC_paths: SELECT e.* FROM edge e JOIN Section s ON s.node_id=e.src_id WHERE e.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' ORDER BY e.edge_id
queries.Spec: SELECT * FROM Spec ORDER BY node_id
